policy: The current camera recommendation catalog covers cameras a person directly operates handheld, on a tripod, or in a camera rig, where body or fixed-lens choice and ordinary size, weight, viewing, power and lens-system comparisons inform a purchase. Remotely operated robotic/PTZ installation systems require a separate decision model and are deferred, even if they use an interchangeable mount or appear in a Sony consumer gallery.

entries.reason: A remotely operated pan/tilt/zoom full-frame production camera intended for networked or installed operation. Its controller, installation, power, and remote-operation choices are central to purchase decisions; ordinary handheld camera body/weight/viewfinder comparisons do not represent that system.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess when the service offers a professional remote/PTZ purchase flow with control, installation, network, power and system-cost comparisons; review Sony's then-current identity and specifications before ingestion.

entries.reason: Restricted infrared/spectral camera: official Korean page limits buyers to specified scientific, forensic and cultural-preservation institutions and requires a buyer agreement. Spectral filters, purchase eligibility and specialized workflow are not ordinary visible-light body comparisons.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess when restricted spectral-camera purchase/filter workflows can be represented. Do not alias to the visible-light GFX100 II.

entries.reason: Analog film and hybrid printing/consumable workflows need adjacent purchase criteria; Pal is digital, not analog, and requires separate phone/printing workflow assessment.
entries.reconsideration: Reassess as a specialty/adjacent category when instant film format, consumable cost, print workflow and hybrid/phone connectivity can be compared. Evaluate digital Pal separately from analog cameras; recheck then-current individual identity and availability before ingestion. Not a permanent exclusion.

entries.reason: Robotic pan/tilt remote control, network/power and installation workflow requires separate purchase criteria. Ten Korean official cards are retained as deferred candidates, not ingested.
entries.reconsideration: Assess individual then-current identities and directly-operated vs installed/live-system purchase workflow in a separate specialty scope session; no automatic canonical exclusions or alias to ordinary camera bodies.

entries.reason: Live studio camera head/system choices center on CCU/return/intercom/SDI/IP and external recording. Professional status alone is not the reason. AK-PLV100GSJ can output SDI without a CCU; re-evaluate standalone/rig purchase scope individually before ingestion. Five Korean cards are scope candidates, not permanently excluded.
entries.reconsideration: Assess individual then-current identities and directly-operated vs installed/live-system purchase workflow in a separate specialty scope session; no automatic canonical exclusions or alias to ordinary camera bodies.
